questions.question: Prakash, Qadir, Ramesh, Saurabh and Tariq are friends. Ramesh is taller than Qadir but shorter than Saurabh. Prakash is the shortest, and Tariq is taller than Saurabh. Who is the tallest among them?
questions.solution:
**Five friends: **Prakash, Qadir, Ramesh, Saurabh and Tariq are friends.

1) Ramesh is taller than Qadir but shorter than Saurabh.

⇒ **Saurabh > ****Ramesh > Qadir**

2) Prakash is the shortest, and Tariq is taller than Saurabh.

⇒ **Tariq > **Saurabh > Ramesh > Qadir > Prakash

Clearly, Tariq is the tallest among all.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Tariq".**

questions.question:
Which two signs need to be interchanged to make the following equation correct?

189 ÷ 27 − 3 + 29 × 2 = 48
questions.solution:
**BODMAS Rule:**

 [IMAGE: https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/XS2xxxCwdquYntMr-Ja84b3Jc33e7gADlODJiXUrHD_QY_TvFrvttjNKwT2FYjNWGDCDCtKTWJlF8AUkBwSy7uFbqGBN69ekgQfe8zku7FwYd9I4H62s9kZfT-szcbi0pJnHzx1R48FqiwAcaU2DRrFIV_2bFmiF7ej4a8zv2srx4m01u3K5tiIa8RQm] 

Given: 189 ÷ 27 − 3 + 29 × 2 = 48

Option 1) - and ×

After interchanging the sign we get:

⇒ __**189 ÷ 27**__ × 3 + 29 - 2 = 48

⇒ __**7 × 3**__ + 29 -2 = 48

⇒ __**21 + 29**__ - 2 = 48

⇒ 50 -2 = 48

⇒ 48 = 48

⇒ **LHS = RHS **

Option 2) + and × 

After interchanging the sign we get:

⇒ __**189 ÷ 27**__ − 3 × 29 + 2 = 48 

⇒ 7 - __**3 × 29**__ + 2 = 48

⇒ **7** - 87 **+ 2** = 48

⇒ 9 - 87 = 48

⇒ - 78 ≠ 48

⇒ **LHS ≠ R****HS**

Option 3) ÷ and -

After interchanging the sign we get:

⇒ 189 - __**27 ÷ 3**__ + 29 × 2 = 48

⇒ 189 - 9 + __**29 × 2**__ = 48

⇒ __**189 **__- 9 __**+ 58**__ = 48

⇒ __**247 - 9 **__= 48

⇒ 238 ≠ 48

⇒ **LHS ≠ RHS**

Option 4) − and +

After interchanging the sign we get:

⇒ __**189 ÷ 27**__ + 3 - 29 × 2 = 48

⇒ 7 + 3 - __**29 × 2**__ = 48

⇒ __**7 + 3**__ - 58 = 48

⇒ __**10 - 58 **__= 48

⇒ - 48 ≠ 48

⇒ **LHS ≠ RHS**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**

questions.question: A cube of side 18 cm is painted yellow on all the faces and then cut into smaller cubes of sides 3 cm each. Find the number of smaller cubes that have only two faces painted.
questions.solution:
A cube of side 18 cm is painted yellow on all the faces and then cut into smaller cubes of sides 3 cm each.

Cube is divided into 18/3 = 6 equal parts, hence n = 6.

Number of cubes with 2 sides painted = 12 (n - 2)

= 12 (6 - 2)

= 12 × 4

= 48 

Hence, '**48**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some telephones are mobiles.

All mobiles are tablets.

Some tablets are laptops.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some mobiles are laptops.

II. All telephones are tablets.

III. Some telephones are tablets.

options.text: All conclusions I, II and III follow.
Only conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/059fd635f0c0cd9a7d2fbba0e603bd44ee23c4bff9f1a6aa0b0a62528c58647f.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some mobiles are laptops → Does not follow → (As, all mobiles are tablets and some tablets are laptops, So some mobile are laptop is possible but not definite true)

II. All telephones are tablets → Does not follow → (As, some telephones are mobiles, all mobiles are tablets and some tablets are laptops. So, all telephone being tablets are possibility but not definite true)

III. Some telephones are tablets → Follow → (As, some telephones are mobiles and all mobiles are tablets. So, some telephone are tablets are definite true)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion III follows".**
